title: Futures: ES/NQ, Margin & Contract Specs
subtitle: Index, energy and rate futures from the contract spec up: multipliers, margin, roll, sessions and the risks of leverage.
what_you_learn: Read a CME contract specification and turn it into dollars: multiplier, tick value, hours, expiry and settlement for ES, NQ, MES and MNQ
Why futures margin is a performance bond, how SPAN sets it, and the leverage arithmetic of a 2% and 5% move against the CME margin table
How daily mark-to-market and variation margin work, and exactly when and how large a margin call is, on a real June 2026 ES sequence
Contango, backwardation and cost-of-carry fair value, and how to roll a quarterly position with a calendar spread while reading continuous charts correctly
The Globex clock: where ES volume actually sits by hour, the 9:30 open, the 4:00 close, holiday sessions, and what that does to fills and slippage
Survey-depth working knowledge of crude oil (CL) and Treasury (ZN/ZB) futures, Section 1256 60/40 tax treatment, and a per-contract risk plan sized for a $25,000 account
